title: Cross-App Study Mix Balance
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:sync study_source=*
| stats count as items by study_source
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how study events split across study source for cross-app learning balance.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside cross-app learning balance.
implementation: Capture each study events event in `language:sync` and normalize `study_source` so Splunk can compute the share by study source.
visualization: Table of study source with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how study events are divided across study source so you can tell if one part of cross-app learning balance is taking over.
